The core conflict is the tension between the user's engineering mindset, which requires objective, quantifiable criteria and measurable success, and the non-objective, value-creating nature of taste-based professions.

The AI reframes 'taste' as a data processing system by analyzing the user's engineering background, defining taste as expert pattern recognition rather than opinion, and creating a parallel between engineering skills and tasting skills.
The AI is trying to bridge the gap between individual sensory processing and shared social agreement.
